## Summary
This package defines the SFU bandwidth estimation contract and shared estimator state types. It provides enum values for estimator strategy and congestion state, plus interfaces for REMB, TWCC, RTT, probing, and congestion-state callbacks.

## Responsibilities
- Define default RTT and RTT smoothing constants.
- Represent bandwidth estimation strategy types.
- Represent congestion states reported by bandwidth estimation implementations.
- Declare the BWE interface for feedback handling, packet send tracking, probing, and state reporting.
- Declare the listener interface for congestion state changes.
